scope: Independent passive RC/ideal-switch cross-check at MIX_OUT only
limitations: 100 ns input/switch transitions approximate analytical instantaneous events.
No gate charge, real JFET, detector delay, tube PI, speaker or perceptual silence qualification.

checks.name: squared voltage integral agrees within 0.5 percent

runs.name: native-no-mute
runs.deck:
Passive wet fault cross-check: incremental 33 V change, ideal switches
Vfault source 0 PWL(0 0 .001 0 .0010001 33 .011 33 .0110001 0 .101 0)
R616 source outac 100
C607 outac wet 1u
R617 wet 0 1meg
R618 wet mix 1meg
Rreturn mix 0 200k
R24 mix 0 10meg
.options method=gear maxord=2 reltol=1e-7 abstol=1e-12 vntol=1e-9
.save v(mix) v(wet)
.tran 2e-06 .101 0 2e-06
.end
